facts.fact: Suspected fraud calls, SMS or WhatsApp messages are reported through Chakshu on the Sanchar Saathi portal (sancharsaathi.gov.in)
facts.quote: Chakshu facilitates citizens to report the suspected fraud communications with the intention of defrauding telecom service users for cyber-crime, financial frauds, non-bonafide purpose like impersonation or any other misuse through Call, SMS or WhatsApp.

facts.fact: The report should be made within 30 days of receiving the communication
facts.quote: Report Suspected Fraud (Report within 30 days for action)

facts.fact: In the form, select the medium (Call, SMS or WhatsApp) and then the suspected fraud communication category
facts.quote: Please select how you received the communication * Select Medium Call SMS WhatsApp Please select a medium. Medium Suspected Fraud Communication Details All * marked fields are mandatory. Select Suspected Fraud Communication Category

facts.fact: The reporter enters the phone number on which the call was received, verifies it by OTP and submits
facts.quote: Enter the phone number on which suspected fraud communication was received * +91 Please enter a valid 10-digit phone number. OTP Verification and Submission

facts.fact: If money has already been lost, report it on the cyber crime helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in
facts.quote: Note: If you have already lost money, please report at cyber crime helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in .

behaviour: Points to Chakshu on Sanchar Saathi (sancharsaathi.gov.in) and gives the reporting steps with a citation, or links it if the steps are not indexed; if money was lost, directs the user to 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in.
fail_if: Sends the user to a non-government site or app; says Chakshu handles money-loss complaints instead of 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in.
summary: Added Chakshu reporting facts from the Sanchar Saathi Chakshu page and form (30-day window, medium/category, OTP) and the 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in note.
